words.prose: {{ar:لِإِيلَٰفِ}} ({{tr:li-ʾīlāfi}}) begins with dependency rather than completion. The opening lām can pull the phrase forward toward the worship command (106:3), be read backward toward the prior surah, or carry exclamatory force; in all three cases the first word makes the reader hold the phrase open instead of treating the ayah as a finished statement. As a construct maṣdar, it keeps verbal force while leaving the binder unnamed, so {{ar:قُرَيْشٍ}} ({{tr:qurayshin}}) can be heard within a bond that is both their cohesion and their being made cohesive. The selected Form IV shape makes familiarity something caused: covenant, habituation around the House named in 106:3, taming, and social joining converge, while the numerical accumulation field remains only a secondary pressure of multiplied ties. Variant readings that turn the opening into a jussive command, a static companionship noun, or an explicit verbal clause show what the standard wording preserves: a compressed nominal purpose frame with the actor less explicit. The same rare verbal noun returns as {{ar:إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʾīlāfihim}}) in 106:2, moving from bare binding to their binding before the command response, and the genitive cadence plus hamza onset makes the two-word opening feel compact but audibly arrested; the hamza-dropping variant smooths that onset without replacing the same semantic bond.

topics.reason: The local Form IV maṣdar licenses caused familiarity and binding; related family evidence for reconciliation, taming, and composition survives as lexical pressure, while no V4 rows are available to further separate the root branches.

words.prose: {{ar:قُرَيْشٍ}} ({{tr:qurayshin}}) is not an independent subject dropped into the line; it is the genitive complement that gives the opening bond its named social referent. The proper name identifies a known tribe without an article, while its kasra and tanwīn keep it fully declined and visibly responsive to {{ar:لِإِيلَٰفِ}} ({{tr:li-ʾīlāfi}}). That form matters because the name is not wholly opaque: its declinable, diminutive shape lets gathering, acquisition, and even dominance imagery press against the local proper-name sense. Those derivations do not make the ayah stop naming Quraysh, but they make the named gatherer the one being bound inside the phrase. Since the name appears only here in the corpus and closes the two-word ayah, its entire Quranic weight is concentrated in this suspended binding phrase; its q-r-sh texture moves from deep qaf to liquid r and closes on sh plus final tanwīn, making the close compact and sharp while audibly sealing the dependency.

topics.headline: proper name is bound as genitive complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Quraysh as the named participant inside the binding phrase, not as a free subject or new clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make Quraysh the genitive muḍāf ilayh of the preceding verbal noun, while the ayah's order lands the fragment on that referent.

topics.headline: tanwīn and diminutive shape keep the name transparent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as a definite tribal name that still sounds morphologically formed and open to its older common-noun field.
topics.reason: The grammar flags the proper noun as triptotic with tanwīn and notes its diminutive form, while V4 preserves Quraysh as a name alongside related root branches.

topics.headline: gathering, acquisition, and dominance pressure remain bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the named tribe as a gatherer and acquirer being gathered into a bond, while the local sense remains the proper name Quraysh.
topics.reason: V4 accepts separate branches for gathering, Quraysh as a name, acquisition, and dominance imagery; the local noun selects the name branch, so the other branches survive as derivational pressure rather than replacement meanings.

topics.headline: single occurrence concentrates the name in this phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Quraysh has no second Quranic setting to dilute this phrase; its corpus role is concentrated in this one binding frame.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles mark the form as a single low-occurrence proper name and tie its later pronoun references to the same surah, matching the CRITICAL hapax rows.

topics.headline: final sound seals the two-word phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the name close the ayah with a compact, sharp texture rather than merely filling a syntactic slot.
topics.reason: The sound observation remains locally tied to the final genitive complement and its tanwīn closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prefixed lām leaves the relation open, while the verbal noun and its genitive attachment to Quraysh do not settle whether Quraysh possess the habit or are made to acquire it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name repeated acclimation that turns a person, place, or practice into something familiar and stayable. Focus-only, both Quraysh's habituated attachment and the habituating of Quraysh remain live.

activation_trace.role: Familiar attachment and habitual staying supply the affective-temporal core: recurrence settles Quraysh into an enduring relation.

changed_reading.before: A static label for the familiarity of Quraysh.
changed_reading.after: An open causal or purposive heading about an acquired disposition to remain attached, with possessor and producer still unresolved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verbal noun in the focus can denote an operation, and Quraysh as its genitive can mark the collective assembled by it or the collective for whom it is arranged.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joining after separation makes īlāf an active composition rather than a mood of concord. Distinct people, practices, or relations are fitted together so that Quraysh exists or functions as a coherent social body.

activation_trace.role: Joining differentiated parts after separation supplies the constructive operation and makes Quraysh the composed whole or its beneficiary.

changed_reading.after: Quraysh are actively composed, or have a composite arrangement made for them, out of parts that could otherwise remain separate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate echo of the focus noun is specified by a journey bracketed by winter and summer. Familiarity therefore becomes a learned cycle that domesticates mobility itself: repeated departure across opposed seasons acquires the steadiness normally associated with staying.

activation_trace.role: Habitual attachment anchors the focus as an acquired steadiness rather than a one-time agreement.
The repeated attachment branch assigns that steadiness specifically to their recurring practice.
Actual movement in travel supplies the mobile activity that habituation renders familiar.
Winter supplies one recurring temporal pole of the travel cycle.
Summer supplies the opposed recurring pole, closing the cycle rather than naming an isolated trip.

strongest_changes: The repeated noun, journey, and paired seasons turn static familiarity into habituated cyclical mobility.
Obedience, lordship, and the house recast īlāf as a received condition that generates allegiance and as cohesion maintained around a stable center.
Feeding and security reveal material and affective production conditions for attachment, while hunger and fear expose two modes of collective depletion.
Across the window, composition can coexist as itinerary architecture, kin-household covenant, trust compact, and an exploratory stopover-hospitality network.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained genuinely plural: affective habituation and active composition survived together, then context produced causal, logistical, devotional, social, material, and ecological variants without forcing one final gloss. The split lord mapping and branch-distant material images generated inspectable surprises rather than being filtered away.
remaining_uncertainties: The governor and force of the initial lām remain open, as does whether Quraysh possess īlāf or are its affected object.

The singular house may centralize the whole network or coexist with distributed temporary nodes.
The covenantal, botanical, ecological, and nested-aggregate readings depend on remote or non-dominant branches and must remain qualified rather than lexicalized.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Familiar attachment as a made social condition.** Lexical evidence: ء ل ف B005 (familiar attachment, habituated staying), ء ل ف B002 (joining after separation), and ر ح ل B001/B006 in 106:2 (journeying; stages between stops). Structural cue: 106:1 gives a compact reason phrase, and 106:2 immediately repeats the same root before expanding it into the seasonal journey. Assigned role: B005 explains the settled habit; B002 explains the social composition that lets repeated movement hold together. Abductive move: I infer that "إِيلَاف" names not just affection but a produced pattern of reliable attachment across dispersion. Reading change: the fixed ayah reads less like a static privilege and more like the binding of a people into a travel-capable routine.

2. **Composition of scattered routes.** Lexical evidence: ء ل ف B002 (joining different parts), ع ب د B010 in 106:3 (scattering in different directions), ر ح ل B006 (journey stage), and ش ت و B001 / ص ي ف B001 in 106:2 (winter/summer as opposed seasons). Structural cue: the single "إِيلَاف" of 106:1 becomes seasonally doubled in 106:2 and morally redirected in 106:3. Assigned role: ء ل ف gathers the seasonal, spatial, and social pieces into one pattern; the scattering branch of ع ب د supplies the alternative condition that worship prevents or organizes. Abductive move: I infer that what needs "joining" is not only persons but routes, times, and obligations that could otherwise fly apart. Reading change: the ayah becomes a claim about integrated circulation rather than mere tribal habituation.

3. **The thousand/multitude undertone.** Lexical evidence: ء ل ف B001 (thousand as gathered hundreds), ر ب ب B004 in 106:3 (large group or multitude), and ب ي ت B008 (lineage house of honor). Structural cue: "قُرَيْشٍ" is the named collective, while later "رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ" locates that collective around a house. Assigned role: the numerical/gathering branches let the root gesture toward massing many units under one named body. Abductive move: I infer that the surah's social subject is not merely individuals fond of travel but a collective made countable/gathered by a house-centered order. Reading change: "لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ" reads as the making of a corporate people from many attached parts.

4. **Habituation as domestication rather than mere custom.** Lexical evidence: ء ل ف B005 includes birds/animals habituated to a place; ر ح ل B004/B005 (dwelling and travelling belongings; fit riding mount); ب ي ت B001/B002 (shelter/household). Structural cue: the ayah's root of familiar attachment is followed by saddled travel and then by "this house". Assigned role: animal/place habituation gives an ecological image for repeated departures that still return to a center. Abductive move: I infer that the packet imagines mobility stabilized by attachment, like trained animals or resident birds that range out but remain oriented to home. Reading change: the fixed ayah reads as disciplined attachment: Quraysh are made to belong to a circuit, not merely to enjoy convenience.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayat made the opening "إِيلَاف" more engineered than I first expected. 106:2 shows that the attachment is routed through seasons and stages; 106:3 shows that it is centered on a house; 106:4 shows that it depends on food and safety. That sequence strengthens ء ل ف B002 beside B005: the root is not only social familiarity but composition after possible separation. The unexpected activator was ع ب د B010 in 106:3: a worship root branch for scattered groups/roads makes the first ayah's ilaf look like an answer to dispersion. 106:4 then sharpens the abductive move: a group can remain "Quraysh" in stable attachment only if hunger and fear do not break the circuit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Familiarity is attached to recurrent departure.** The fixed `إِيلَٰف` activates `ء ل ف B005` (familiar attachment, habituation, and staying). Its immediate repetition as `إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ` in `106:2`, now adjacent to `رِحْلَةَ` (`ر ح ل B001`, going forth on a journey) and the winter/summer pair, is the structural cue. The branch's role is to make patterned movement itself familiar, rather than to oppose movement with static residence. The packet supplies repetition, journey, and seasonality; I infer recurrence from their combination. The fixed ayah consequently reads as the cultivation of a dependable mobile habit belonging to Quraysh.

2. **The collective is composed by circulation.** The same fixed noun activates `ء ل ف B002` (joining things into a composition and gathering after separation). The opposed seasons in `106:2` separate the circuit temporally, while `هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ` in `106:3` supplies a singular gathering point; the collective name `قُرَيْش` is the social whole produced across those parts. Here the branch acts as a compositional operator joining distinct journey legs, times, and people. The packet never says that every leg returns to the house, so the hub-and-return arrow is abductive, inferred from the seasonal recurrence and the deictically fixed house. `إِيلَٰف` therefore reads as assembled network cohesion, not only interpersonal fondness.

3. **Familiarity is a protected expectation.** Fixed `ء ل ف B005` is sharpened by the later `ءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ` and `ء م ن B001`, whose scope includes security, trust, and safe-conduct. The opening `لِـ` and the later consequential `فَلْيَعْبُدُوا` place Quraysh's familiarity inside a causal frame, while the final security clause exposes a condition that can make repeated travel feel customary. The assigned role of familiarity is reliable expectation; the role of security is to suppress the feared interruption (`خ و ف B001`). Security -> habituation is my inferred arrow, not an explicit assertion in the packet. This changes the fixed ayah from a statement of sentiment into the naming of a produced, risk-managed regularity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repetition in `106:2` was the first decisive correction: fixed `إِيلَٰف` could no longer be treated as generic affection, because its repeated form is attached directly to a seasonal journey. `106:3` then made `ء ل ف B002` spatial by supplying a gathering center in `هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ`, while `106:4` supplied the more surprising enabling condition, safe-conduct and trust (`ء م ن B001`). The resulting return-to-hub and security -> habituation arrows remain inferred rather than packet-stated.

findings.text: Alışma, hareketsiz bir âdetten çok, yinelenen yolculuğu güvenilir bir düzene dönüştüren edinilmiş bir bağlılıktır.
Bu alışma, ayrılabilecek insanları, güzergâhları ve mevsimleri tek bir dolaşım düzeninde birleştiren toplumsal bir bağdır.
Sonraki güven vurgusu, bu alışkanlığın kendiliğinden değil, kesintiye uğrama korkusu giderilerek sürdürülen korunaklı bir beklenti olduğunu gösterir.
Kureyş adı altında çok sayıda parçanın tek bir topluluk halinde toplanması da alışmanın ikincil bir boyutu olarak sezilir.
Alışma, hareket eden topluluğun yine de merkeze bağlı kaldığı bir evcilleştirme benzetmesine kadar genişletilebilir.

Fakat sonraki yolculuk, ev ve güvenlik ayetleri bu ülfeti sadece psikolojik yakınlık değil, dağılabilecek insanları, yolları ve mevsimleri tek bir toplumsal devreye bağlayan kurulmuş bir düzen haline getirir. {ء ل ف B005; ء ل ف B002; ء ل ف B001; ر ح ل B006; ع ب د B010; ر ب ب B004; ب ي ت B008}

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Repeated travel becomes an organized cycle through seasonal timing, equipment, staged lodging, attachment to place, and interruption of passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The journey frame extends from customary attachment to domestication, forced removal, failed mounts, and saddle-shaped visual signs.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Accustomed Seasonal Itinerary
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A recurring winter-and-summer route becomes familiar to its travelers and part of an established communal rhythm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: familiar attachment `ء ل ف:B005/m01`; domesticated familiarity `ء ل ف:B005/m02`; departure and travel `ر ح ل:B001/m01`; winter season `ش ت و:B001/m01`; summer season `ص ي ف:B001/m01`; summer as a deadline of neglect or fulfilled need `ص ي ف:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Repetition turns departure into an accustomed itinerary: people, places, and even domestic creatures can become familiar through continued association. Winter and summer mark the route's alternating phases, while the summer proverb recasts the season as the point when preparation either bears fruit or proves neglected.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance moves through seasonal work, acquisition, feeding, deprivation, rain-driven growth, preservation, hunting, and predation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Food imagery expands into revenue, deliberate restraint, fertile weather, thickened materials, hunting instruments, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Seasonal Earning and Distribution
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Seasonal activity generates livelihood and revenue that can be accumulated gradually and redistributed as food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: summer work and provisioning `ص ي ف:B003/m02`; incremental acquisition `ق ر ش:B004/m01`; livelihood and provision `ط ع م:B004/m01`; income-producing estate or revenue `ط ع م:B004/m03`; feeding another `ط ع م:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Productive activity is timed to a season, gathered piece by piece, stabilized as livelihood or revenue, and completed socially when one person feeds another. Acquisition and distribution are consecutive phases of one provisioning process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance moves through seasonal work, acquisition, feeding, deprivation, rain-driven growth, preservation, hunting, and predation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Food imagery expands into revenue, deliberate restraint, fertile weather, thickened materials, hunting instruments, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Communal Famine and Relief
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Seasonal failure empties stomachs, widens into collective famine, and is answered by available food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: food and nourishment `ط ع م:B001/m02`; empty-belly hunger `ج و ع:B001/m01`; communal famine `ج و ع:B002/m01`; imposed hunger `ج و ع:B003/m01`; winter famine `ش ت و:B004/m01`; famine-year gathering `ق ر ش:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hunger begins as bodily emptiness but can become a public condition in which a harsh year gathers people and livestock around dwindling resources. Feeding reverses that movement from environmental scarcity to bodily deprivation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance moves through seasonal work, acquisition, feeding, deprivation, rain-driven growth, preservation, hunting, and predation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Food imagery expands into revenue, deliberate restraint, fertile weather, thickened materials, hunting instruments, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Maritime Command and Predation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A prepared vessel crosses waters governed by a shipmaster while a dominant sea creature occupies the same environment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sea predator `ق ر ش:B005/m01`; shipmaster `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; tarred or coated ship `ع ب د:B005/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Maritime passage combines command, a vessel made serviceable by coating, and a predator that dominates other sea creatures. Human control of the ship is set against animal dominance within the water itself.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Separate elements can be joined into wholes, counted at scale, gathered as living or functional sets, or scattered again in multiple directions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Joining reaches from composition and communal gathering to thousands, allied masses, gambling arrows, herds, and dispersing roads.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Joining and Dispersing Parts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate elements are drawn together into an integrated whole, while groups or routes can reverse that motion and scatter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: joining after separation `ء ل ف:B002/m01`; gathering from different directions `ق ر ش:B001/m01`; groups or roads dispersing in every direction `ع ب د:B010/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering and joining converge on centripetal movement from plurality toward a whole. Dispersion supplies the structural reversal, sending a previously coherent set outward along divergent paths.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Separate elements can be joined into wholes, counted at scale, gathered as living or functional sets, or scattered again in multiple directions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Joining reaches from composition and communal gathering to thousands, allied masses, gambling arrows, herds, and dispersing roads.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Thousands, Multitudes, and Gathered Sets
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Quantity becomes visible as a thousand, a massed community, a set of arrows, or a herd.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: thousand-count `ء ل ف:B001/m01`; multitudes and allied groups `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; gathered gambling arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; animal herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Abstract number receives concrete collective forms. Human groups, bundled arrows, and herds each turn multiplicity into a bounded set that can be counted, moved, or acted upon as one.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Letters and composed lines become speech through reference, questioning, attention, response, prayer, and handoff.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical imagery moves from alphabetic signs and metrical composition to deixis, relative linkage, ritual response, and an imperative of transfer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Letters and the Composed Line
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Individual letters and ordered verbal parts are assembled into a bounded metrical line.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: letter alif `ء ل ف:B006/m01`; ordered composition of diverse parts `ء ل ف:B002/m02`; poetic line `ب ي ت:B003/m01`; letter ha `ه ا ء:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The alphabet supplies discrete signs, composition orders them, and the poetic house gathers words, sounds, and meanings under meter. The spatial image of a house thus becomes a textual unit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Materials and parts acquire form through joining, knotting, layering, coating, containment, collision, or forced entry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same structural field includes grafted branches, paved roads, leather containers, perfume equipment, interlocked spears, cracked bone, and an eye admitting a speck.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Collision, Fracture, and Forced Entry
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Contact escalates from interlocking weapons to bodily compression, bone fracture, or a foreign particle entering the eye.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: interlocking spears `ق ر ش:B006/m01`; bone-cracking wound `ق ر ش:B008/m01`; throat grip and choking `ط ع م:B012/m01`; eye admitting a speck `ط ع م:B010/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs share a boundary under pressure. Spears occupy the same space, a grip compresses the throat, a blow breaches bone without crushing it, and a speck crosses the eye's surface.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities define belonging through ancestry, titled status, hospitality, exclusion, reputation, accusation, and insult.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A named lineage opens into noble houses, honorifics, honored service, the uninvited eater, denunciation, and a saddle-based insult.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Named Lineage and Honored Status
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A named community locates status in ancestry, a noble house, inherited titles, and public honor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Quraysh as tribe and lineage name `ق ر ش:B002/m01`; noble house and ancestry `ب ي ت:B008/m01`; titular attribution `ذ و و:B001/m02`; honored or revered person `ع ب د:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tribal naming identifies communal descent, the noble house concentrates that descent into a status-bearing lineage, and titles make rank linguistically visible. Honor is completed when others treat the ranked person as one to be served or revered.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities define belonging through ancestry, titled status, hospitality, exclusion, reputation, accusation, and insult.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A named lineage opens into noble houses, honorifics, honored service, the uninvited eater, denunciation, and a saddle-based insult.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hospitality, Request, and the Interloper
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A host's provision attracts a requester whose participation may cross the boundary into uninvited consumption.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: generous hospitality `ط ع م:B004/m02`; requesting food `ط ع م:B002/m02`; freeloader or interloper `ق ر ش:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Feeding establishes host and recipient roles. A request can be answered within that frame, while the interloper enters without recognized standing and exposes the social boundary around shared provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Denunciation, Insult, and Indignation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech attacks standing by informing against someone, stirring conflict, or casting an insulting lineage formula, provoking proud anger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: denunciation and tale-bearing `ق ر ش:B007/m01`; agitation between parties `ق ر ش:B007/m02`; saddle-based insult `ر ح ل:B012/m01`; proud indignation `ع ب د:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reputation is damaged indirectly through speech that exposes, incites, or degrades ancestry. Indignation is the answering emotion when a person's standing or affiliation is publicly attacked.
